scope: Training-pool selector diagnostic:96prompts from v83 training only,48fit48internal-validation. Reused workloads, not final test or speed.
method: Freeze backbone/unary candidates; multiply predecessor-conditioned transition correction by one scalar. Select scalar on fit prompts separately for each width, evaluate once on internal validation.
oracle: Gold token presence in unary candidates gives hindsight accepted-prefix ceiling; not a deployable selector.
gates: Original v83 input and teacher sequence identical
Scale1 proposed IDs exactly reproduce v83 for every anchor/width
Target full sequence greedy replay exact
First anchor independently verified, causal features invariant
decision: If candidate ceiling lacks10% validation reward headroom, stop selector direction. If selected scalar gives>=10% validation reward, require fresh prompts and matched end-to-end serving. Otherwise no scalar-calibration speed claim; do not retune validation.
prior_art: DFlash2 already adds a predecessor-conditioned correction. Scaling it is an ablation/calibration baseline, not a claimed novel architecture. Acceptance-oriented drafter training also has prior work.
